static.solution:
Solution:
a) This is a left endpoint Riemann sum. Its value is: f(0) \cdot \frac{\pi}{4} + f\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right) \cdot \frac{\pi}{4} + f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) \cdot \frac{\pi}{4} + f\left(\frac{3\pi}{4}\right) \cdot \frac{\pi}{4} = \left(0 + \frac{2 \sqrt{2}}{2} + 2 + \frac{2 \sqrt{2}}{2}\right) \cdot \frac{\pi}{4} = 3.79224.
b) This is a right endpoint Riemann sum. Its value is: f\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right) \cdot \frac{\pi}{4} + f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) \cdot \frac{\pi}{4} + f\left(\frac{3\pi}{4}\right) \cdot \frac{\pi}{4} + f(\pi) \cdot \frac{\pi}{4} = \left(\frac{2 \sqrt{2}}{2} + 2 + \frac{2 \sqrt{2}}{2} + 0\right) \cdot \frac{\pi}{4} = 3.79224.
